basic_profile.bio: Living in the vibrant city of London, I'm a sound engineer by day and an electronic music enthusiast by night. My passion for cycling often takes me through the scenic routes of the city, where I find inspiration for my next composition. I spend my evenings experimenting with soundscapes and diving deep into the world of music synthesis. Currently in a relationship, my partner often joins me on my cycling adventures. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, just before I dive into my music projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Sound Engineering from a prestigious London university, I have honed my skills in audio editing and music production. My interest in synthesizers and electronic music led me to self-teach the intricacies of various music equipment, including Behringer gear, through online resources and community forums.
